contentText: The Security Council has been briefed by some of the world's top AI executives on the huge benefits and huge risks the frontier technology presents. With warnings mounting that the world may be losing its grip on systems built to outthink us, Yoshua Bengio, Co-Chair of the UN-backed Independent International Scientific Panel on AI, said the dangers of AI beyond human control represent an unprecedented threat for countries “that none can contain alone – and that does not respect the borders we defend.”
